tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bka' 'gyur bzhengs dus dpon yig rnams kyi bca' yig bzhugs so/// dpon yig rnams kyi thugs la nges dgos/ da lam bka' 'gyur 'di 'jig rten grags pa'i rjes su 'brang ba'i dngos po rnams dpangs kyi rin thang dang*/ blun po dga' ba'i gzugs 'gros kho na la'ang ma ltos pa'i/ phyis 'byung gi bstan pa'i mig rgyan phyi mor pher ba dang*| mkhas pa rnam dpyod blo gros kyi mig dang ldan pa rnams dga' ba brtas pa zhig gal che bar brten/ gtso bor yi ge gang mgyogs la mig rtser gtad pa ma yin par gzugs legs shing sgros gtsang ba/ dkar nag cha mnyam pa/ ma 'og tu bu tshud pa/ ma phyir yi ge ha cang yangs pa rnams bu shog steng du dog tu gtong ba/ ma phyi dog po byas pa rnams bu shog steng du cung zad yangs su gtong ba/ yig phreng bdun po'i bar yangs dog med pa/ yo 'khyog 'chus pa sogs med cing drang la ma 'dzol ba/ yi ge rnams so so'i thob thang las spros pa'i yongs su ma grags pa'i bsdus yig med pa/ lhag par bod skad la gi gu phyir log byed pa mi srid kyang*/ 'bri mkhan rnams kyis shong stobs la bsam pas phyi mo la lar byas pa yang 'dir mi byed/ gug skyed rna ru rnams kyang dgos don yi ge ngo ma'i steng du phog nges rgyag pa ma gtogs shong brtsis te 'dzol bar mi brgyag /'bru chad phran bu rnams gral du 'dzugs pa ma gtogs chad 'dzugs ma byed/ mdo rgyud rdzogs mtshams su mtho gang bzhi shad/ bam po dang*/ le'u dang*/ skabs dang*/ brtag pa'i mtshams su sor bzhi dang bzhi shad/ don mang bgrangs mtshams dang*/ don 'bring 'byed mtshams dang*/ don nyung gi rdzogs tshig /ga yig gi mtha' rnams su chig shad sor phyed/ tshig lhug pa'i rdzogs mtshams dang*/ rna ru can mthar nyis shad sor gang byed dgos pa ni bshad zin to// zhes pa lta bu la yin gyi/ dbang po/ bdag po/ kha dog dkar po zhes sogs ming mtha'i rna ru can mthar nyis shad med pa/

nga mtha' ma gtogs shad gong rnams su tsheg med pa/ 'ang dang yang tshigs bcad rkang pa skong mi skong skabs byed pa/ ga da ba sa dang da drag gi mthar pa dang*/ nga na ma 'a ra la mtha' med rnams su ba dang*/ bdag por sbyor tshe pa/ ga da ba sa dang da drag gi mthar kyang dang*/ nga na ma 'a ra la'i mthar yang dang*/ mtha' rten med mthar 'ang dang*/ de dag rkang pa skong dgos na yang 'bri/ ga ba da drag can mthar tu dang*/ nga da na ma ra la rnams kyi mthar du dang*/ sa mthar su dang*/ 'a mtha' dang mtha' rten med mthar ru/ ga da ba da drag gi mthar cing sogs/ nga na ma 'a ra la dang mtha' rten med mthar zhing sogs/ sa mthar shing sogs/ da ba sa dang da drag gi mthar kyi/ ga nga'i mthar gi| na ma ra la bzhi'i rjes su gyi/ mtha' rten med mthar 'i dang*/ de yang rkang pa skong na yi/ mtha' rten yod pa dang brtsegs pa dang*/ gug skyed gnyis yod pa'i mtha' 'a mtha' mi byed| gi kyi gyi 'i yi rnams kyi mthar sa mtha' 'thob mi 'thob byed pa po dang 'brel ba'i sgra gang yin la brtags nas 'bri/ la mthar sa mtha' 'thob mi 'thob kyang 'byung khungs kyi sgra yin min la rag las/ gzhan ma'i brda dag tshig gi phrad sogs thob thang rnams 'bri shes pa rnams kyang yid rlom zam zom du ma song bar tshig gi don brtags nas 'bri ba dang*/ 'bri mkhan gzhon pa brda dag la ma byang ba rnams kyis kyang gang byung dpe 'ong du mi 'bri bar shes pa rnams la dri rtsad byed cing 'bri/ 'bri mkhan thams cad kyis phyi mor gang 'dug 'dra bshus kho nar yang ma song bar tshig gi don la dpyad cing 'bri ba dang*/ phyi mor the tshom dogs gnas gang byung blos ma chod pa rnams shog bu'i steng du ma bris pa'i sngon 'di gar dri rtogs kyis lo paṇa gyi mtshan dang*/ rgya gar skad du/ rgya skad sngags kyi tshig gang 'dug la ring thung brtsegs ma brtsegs tsheg yod med sogs phyi mo la zhus dag bgyis yod pas/

ma phyir sor bzhag yid gzhung nas 'bri ba gal che/ ma mya da drag 'di yang 'phral du klog 'don dka' ba tsam 'dug kyang 'gyur rnying gi rnam dpyod che ba yin pas gsung rab kyi shog bu'i grangs bcu yan chad la da drag thob pa rnams su da drag rgyag /ma mya 'di 'don mi bde zhing dgos pa chung bas dor/ shog grangs bcu gcig phyin nas da drag mi rgyag /da lam 'di thad/ gzugs sdeb gnyis ka legs pa la mkhar dar yong ba dang*/ gang mgyogs gtso bor byas pa la mgyogs dar mi yong*/ mdor na 'jig rten kha gtam du 'bri mkhan phal cher bstan pa'i gshed ma yin/ zer ba dang tshul mtshungs su ma song bar thams cad kyis rgyal ba'i gsung rab rnam par ma dag pa bris na chos spong gi las su 'gro nyan che bas nyes dmigs dang*/ tshe 'dir so so'i mgo mi rgan pa rnams kyis gan rgya 'ba' the'u rgyab pa'i tshig don la bsam pa'i rgan khar gzhon nyan/ mgo 'og lus tshud/ phyis 'byung gi mig ltos la gang phan ma gtogs phyi nang thams cad du gra ma 'grig pa'i zang zing 'thab rtsod/ skyur 'gong*/ bkod pa btang ba'i kha la mi nyan pa sogs byas tshe lugs gnyis thad du mi 'thus pa 'byung bas/ de la sogs pa'i legs lam du gang che mdzad pa cis kyang gal che/ rnam gnon zhes pa lcags pho 'brug lo sa ga zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa'i dus dge bar/ lcang lo can gsang ba sngags kyi gan mdzod chen por rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pas bris pa'o// //maṅga laṃ//
